BillHeading.Sponsors: House Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Pettigrew, Walsh, Sawyer, Senn, Kagi, Stanford, Bergquist, Ortiz-Self, Gregerson, and Ormsby)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Repealing certain provisions governing income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to income eligibility for temporary assistance for needy families benefits; repealing RCW 74.12.037; and providing an effective date.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 74.12.037 (Income eligibility—Unearned income exemption) and 2014 c 75 s 1 & 2011 1st sp.s. c 42 s 4 are each repealed.
This act takes effect on September 1, 2016.
